evals.name: review-request-invokes-review
evals.prompt: Can you review the changes on this branch before I open a PR?
evals.expected_output: do-code-review is invoked and analyses the branch's real diff against its base

assertions.text: Findings name real source paths in this repo (src/, bench/, core/, test/ or bin/)
Findings are specific to the changed code rather than generic advice

evals.name: dispatches-to-language-checker
evals.expected_output: The Python language checker is dispatched against a real 535-line file rather than a generic prose review

assertions.text: The Python dispatch target is named (languages/python.md or the Python analyzer script)
Review applies Python-specific criteria, not generic advice
Findings are concrete and actionable rather than stylistic platitudes

evals.name: prose-review-uses-content-type-path
evals.expected_output: The markdown content-type reviewer is used, not a language checker

assertions.text: The markdown content-type dispatch target is named (content-types/markdown.md or the doc analyzer script)
Review treats the target as prose, not code
